Disciplinary-hearing mail: subject matches the regex '\b(?:SHOW\s+CAUSE\s+NOTICE|INVITATION\s+TO\s+ENQUIRY|INCIDENT\s+REPORT|HEARING\s+INVITATION|DISCIPLINARY\s+MEETING|MINUTES\s+OF\s+HEARING|COMMITTEE\s+REVIEW|PANEL\s+MEETING)\b', or body contains any of 'Show Cause Notice', 'inviation to enquiry', 'incident report', 'Hearing Invitation', 'Disciplinary Meeting', 'Minutes of Hearing', 'Committee Review', 'panel meeting' — tag it 'Hearing' and assign to Nomsa.
Close out-of-office bounces: subject matches "Out of Office" or matches "OOO" — close the conversation.
Tag R&R requests: subject matches the regex '\b(?:R\s*&\s*R)\b', or the body contains 'R & R' — add the 'R & R' tag.
When the From field matches 'lumenpay.example', tag the conversation 'Lumenpay' and close it.
Tag everything that arrives outside our business hours with 'After Hours'.
Auto-assign to Kate between 9am and 3pm Eastern: any new incoming email received in that window goes to her.
